overview.about: The FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup is the top international championship in women's basketball, held every four years. The United States have dominated its history with eleven titles and a decades-long unbeaten run at the tournament. The 2026 edition is hosted in Berlin, Germany, on 4-13 September.
overview.nextEvent: The 2026 FIBA Women's Basketball World Cup runs 4-13 September in Berlin. Sixteen nations compete for the title, with the USA the overwhelming favourites to extend their record.
